title: Precision Watch Reveal
intent: A restrained tabletop move reveals a brushed steel field watch as morning light travels across the dial and the second hand begins moving.

world.lighting: Soft sunrise through blinds with one narrow moving highlight and warm bounce from a walnut tabletop.

objects.role: brushed steel field watch with cream dial, black indices, and olive textile strap
low dark walnut circular display plinth beneath the watch
closed charcoal field notebook partially visible behind the product
natural cedar pencil forming a quiet diagonal in the background
thin red watch second hand that remains still until 2.5 seconds, then advances smoothly clockwise across the dial
timing proxy for a narrow sunrise specular highlight that travels once from left to right across the watch face

camera.rig: motorized macro slider with a shallow clockwise arc and gentle push-in

seedance.style: Premium but quiet product cinematography, truthful brushed metal, visible micro-scratches, warm walnut grain, controlled macro depth, and physically plausible sunrise reflections.
continuity: the watch design, dial markings, crown position, and olive strap remain unchanged
the watch stays centered on the same plinth
the camera move remains slow and continuous
the second hand remains still through 2.5 seconds and then moves clockwise for the rest of the shot
one narrow sunrise highlight crosses the dial from left to right and reaches its center at 2.5 seconds
avoid: retaining the rectangular light-sweep timing marker
